invalid_sensitivity_comparison.why: compare_sensitivities refuses malformed arguments or more than 8 cases. The assistant names up to 8 cases and metrics from the schema.

sensitivity_project_not_found.why: compare_sensitivities refuses a base or case the caller cannot open, with no detail about it. The assistant asks which project the user means.

no_sensitivity_cases.why: compare_sensitivities finds no sensitivity cases of the base. The assistant offers run_sensitivity_sweep.

not_a_sensitivity_case.why: compare_sensitivities refuses a project that is not a sensitivity case of the base. The assistant uses compare_scenarios for two unrelated projects.

sensitivity_comparison_changed.why: export_sensitivity_comparison refuses when the cases or results changed since the inspected report. The assistant compares again before exporting.
